test: Ornith router projection and expert grouping on gfx1030; synthetic inputs, no model loaded

build.floating_point_flags: Both engine and test: -O3 -std=c++20; no fast-math or reassociation flags

parity.comparison: memcmp over full output allocation, including unwritten sentinels; done counter checked as zero
cases: zero, repeated, small and large activations
HY slot permutations, partial holes and empty maps
parity.reference_limit: For T beyond the original per-block token limit, the frozen reference only extends shared storage and loops the same warp body over tokens. The engine's existing T<=4 fused and T<=8 standalone dispatch limits are unchanged.

microbench.method: HIP events; median of 31 interleaved graph replays with alternating mode order
microbench.timed_baseline: The engine off-switch path: Mask=false, Unroll=1, original shared storage and token dispatch. The widened frozen reference is used for parity only.
microbench.default: One fused launch, same grid and fence/counter pattern; unroll 4 at T=1, unroll 8 otherwise; mask grouping on gfx1030
microbench.split_note: Split is a diagnostic two-launch comparison, not the engine default. It is slower at T=1 and only slightly faster at T=3..4 in the final run.
microbench.hy_empty_T1: 5.648 us old versus 5.656 us new: effectively neutral; no claim of a HY-empty T=1 speedup

experiments.note: In these historical experiment logs, the main BENCH new column is the all-T shared-weight prototype, not the shipped path. The TUNE rows use the mode maps below. Use parity-and-microbench.log for shipped-path results.

mode_mapping.0: all T tokens share each weight load (groups of 4 past T=4)
mode_mapping.3: two tokens share each weight load

experiment-token-reuse.log.result: Weight sharing was slower on this GPU and was removed from production code.

mode_mapping.4: agent acq_rel counter after a CTA barrier, without explicit threadfence

experiment-counter.log.result: Changing just the counter/fence did not provide a repeatable win. Original fence/counter semantics retained.

experiment-unroll.log.result: Ordered unroll 4 at T=1 and 8 at larger T selected; wider unrolling rejected.

profile_T4.method: Direct launches; 8 passes over 48 rotating matrices, old/new/projection/split; timings are not additive

unchanged: route_plan.cu (first-occurrence group ordering, not Ornith's expert-id ordering)
